facts.text: Under the RU-N to the TOP scholarship, qualifying New Jersey residents with a household adjusted gross income of $65,000 or less receive full coverage of in-state tuition and mandatory fees.

facts.text: The RU-N to the TOP program provides a last-dollar financial aid scholarship that covers in-state tuition and mandatory fees based on the student's adjusted gross income tier.
